entries.titleEn: Independence Day 1776 · Script-to-keyframe workflow with Utopai PAI
entries.titleZh: 《独立日 1776》｜Utopai PAI 从剧本到关键帧
entries.summaryEn: A satirical alternate-history short makes a practical case for script-driven production. PAI parses a screenplay into shots, stores recurring character identities, and proposes keyframes for humans to select and refine before animation.
entries.summaryZh: 借一支戏仿历史的短片演示剧本驱动的流程：PAI 将剧本拆为场景和镜头，保存可复用角色身份，并生成关键帧候选，由团队选帧、细化后再做动画。

entries.titleEn: NEXUS: Five Dreamina Workflow Tips
entries.titleZh: NEXUS：Dreamina 制作流程的五个实用技巧
entries.summaryEn: PJ’s follow-up distills the team’s Dreamina workflow into a quick creator-led breakdown: consider several looks, turn the chosen designs into references, and carry selected images into animation.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 用简短视频复盘团队的 Dreamina 工作流：先探索多个方案，再把选中的设计做成参考，最后用挑出的静帧指导动画。

skills.label: Approve before animating
skills.summaryEn: Do not spend motion-generation time on looks that have not been locked.
skills.summaryZh: 在动态生成之前先确认视觉设计，不把动画时间花在方向尚未确定的素材上。

entries.titleEn: Gossip Goblin’s Crazy Workflow for Building Original Worlds (200M+ Views)
entries.titleZh: Gossip Goblin 如何打造原创世界：《The Patchwright》制作访谈

skills.label: Visual anchors
skills.summaryEn: Choose a few defining frames for each place before filling the intervening shots.

skills.summaryEn: Let scene teams work independently while a lead editor retains responsibility for the full cut.

This is a narrow continuity demo, not a complete episode-making course; study the input-control idea rather than expecting the same legacy product to be available.

entries.titleZh: 《约拿》项目：25 分钟 AI 剧集幕后索引
entries.summaryEn: This post introduces a 25-minute episode about Jonah and links out to the author’s video-rich breakdown. The Beehiiv page is a starting point rather than the complete 15-step guide.
entries.summaryZh: 本篇介绍一部 25 分钟的《约拿》剧集，并把读者引向作者在 X 上发布的完整视频流程。Beehiiv 原文是入口，不是完整的 15 步教程。

skills.label: Frame direction
skills.summaryEn: Separate the performance, depth layers and lighting when describing a single shot.
skills.summaryZh: 描述单个镜头时，把表演、景深层次和光线分开写清楚。

resources.labelZh: 《约拿》15 步完整制作长帖

entries.titleEn: Oops, we started the next trend.
entries.titleZh: Popeyes 与 Grok 广告：品牌喜剧与分镜沟通
entries.summaryEn: A recap of spots for Popeyes and Grok leads into PJ’s view on comedy-led branded content, with examples of production shot lists and visual pitches.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 从 Popeyes 与 Grok 两支广告谈到以喜剧带动品牌内容的思路，还举例说明如何用镜头表和动态样片沟通创意。

skills.label: Visual pitch
skills.summaryEn: A short moving example can clarify timing and tone faster than prose alone.
skills.summaryZh: 短动态样片能比单靠文字更直观地传达节奏与语气。

entries.titleEn: Kalshi YOLO: from historical underdogs to a one-week ad
entries.titleZh: Kalshi《YOLO》：从历史逆袭主题到一周广告制作
entries.summaryEn: A separate follow-up to the NBA Finals spot. PJ and head writer Nate Dern scripted it, Theo Dudley directed, outside writers pitched alternative jokes, and client approval of the shot list preceded concept passes.
entries.summaryZh: 它不是 6 月 NBA 总决赛广告，而是另一支后续广告。PJ 和主笔 Nate Dern 构思历史逆袭题材，Theo Dudley 执导，外部写手补备选笑点，客户批准镜头单后才进入概念制作。
entries.imageAltEn: A branching joke board resolving into a checked shot list
entries.imageAltZh: 多个笑点方案汇入一张打勾的镜头清单

entries.titleEn: I can’t believe Disney allowed us to run this AI ad during the NBA Finals 😂
entries.titleZh: Kalshi 广告幕后：Veo 3 的镜头迭代与剪辑
entries.summaryEn: PJ relates how he designed and assembled a Kalshi ad with Veo 3. The case is most useful for understanding the gap between raw generations and the shots that made the cut.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 回顾如何用 Veo 3 设计并剪成一支 Kalshi 广告。这个案例最值得看的是：生成了许多素材，真正能用的镜头却有限。

skills.label: Generation triage
skills.summaryEn: Review alternatives for performance, readability and sound before committing them to the cut.
skills.summaryZh: 入剪前对比候选版本的表演、可读性和声音，而不是只挑画质最好的。

entries.titleEn: My God, what have I done?
entries.titleZh: 圣经人物 Vlog：短视频形式与 Veo 3 制作笔记
entries.summaryEn: PJ reflects on a series that recasts biblical figures as contemporary vloggers, then discusses social format choices and how he structured Veo 3 shots.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 复盘将圣经人物设定为当代视频博主的系列，并延伸到社交平台的形式选择与 Veo 3 镜头的组织方式。

skills.label: Format as point of view
skills.summaryEn: Give the camera an in-world reason to be there, so the delivery format becomes part of the joke.
skills.summaryZh: 给镜头一个在故事里出现的理由，让拍摄形式本身也成为笑点。

resources.labelZh: 《但以理》自拍视角参考与提示词

entries.titleEn: Don’t Miss the Veo 3 Gold Rush
entries.titleZh: Veo 3 早期案例：仿药品广告的喜剧反转
entries.summaryEn: An early Veo 3 experiment starts from a recognizable pharmaceutical-ad format and then subverts it. The piece also discusses script review, generation rejects and editorial choices.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇早期 Veo 3 实验先建立观众熟悉的药品广告套路，再将其反转。文章也谈到脚本筛选、废片判断与剪辑取舍。

skills.label: Reset a failing shot
skills.summaryEn: If repeated takes miss the same beat, change the staging rather than endlessly rerunning it.
skills.summaryZh: 如果重复生成仍解决不了同一个问题，就改调度或换镜头，而不是继续重跑。

entries.titleEn: Midjourney just killed ChatGPT
entries.titleZh: Midjourney Omni Reference：跨场景保留人物外观
entries.summaryEn: This early Omni Reference tutorial tests how a single reference can carry a recognizable identity into different cinematic settings. The headline is rhetorical, not a product comparison.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇 Omni Reference 早期教程测试如何把同一个可辨认的人物带入不同电影场景。英文标题是修辞，不是对两款产品的客观评测。

skills.label: Reference testing
skills.summaryEn: Check the same character across changing framing and lighting, not just in one favored portrait.
skills.summaryZh: 别只看一张满意的肖像；在不同景别和光线里检查是否仍能认出同一个人物。

entries.titleEn: PJ’s Secret Midjourney Prompt
entries.titleZh: PJ 的 Midjourney 电影感提示词结构
entries.summaryEn: A brief prompting lesson demonstrates how naming the camera treatment and visual atmosphere can steer Midjourney toward the intended cinematic frame.
entries.summaryZh: 这篇短教程展示如何把摄影处理方式和画面氛围描述得更明确，让 Midjourney 更贴近预想中的电影画面。

skills.label: Concrete image direction
skills.summaryEn: Specify the framing and texture you want instead of relying on a generic request for a cinematic look.
skills.summaryZh: 与其笼统要求“电影感”，不如直接交代想要的景别与质感。

entries.titleEn: AI Filmmaking Is Taking Off—Here’s How to Catch Up
entries.titleZh: AI 影像创作入门：PJ Ace 通讯发刊词
entries.summaryEn: PJ sets out the newsletter’s educational focus: public notes on AI filmmaking practice for newcomers and working creators. This introductory issue does not teach a specific technique.
entries.summaryZh: PJ 在发刊词中说明通讯面向新手与创作者，计划分享 AI 影像制作经验。这一期是栏目介绍，不是单项技术教程。

entries.titleEn: What We Leave Behind: a low-overhead short-film workflow
entries.titleZh: 《What We Leave Behind》：低成本短片的镜头工作流
entries.summaryEn: PJ builds a shot list in ChatGPT, iterates framings, generates stills with Midjourney v7, upscales selected images 2× in Topaz and uses restrained motion prompts in Kling. He did not finish the planned sound-effects and narration pass in this version.
entries.summaryZh: 用 ChatGPT 拆镜头单并补远景／近景，Midjourney v7 生成静帧，Topaz 放大两倍，最后在 Kling 用简短运动指令动画化。这个版本没有完成原计划的音效和旁白，不宜称完整后期案例。
entries.imageAltEn: Stills progressing from a small frame to a large frame with motion traces
entries.imageAltZh: 小画幅放大后加入运动轨迹的分镜

entries.titleEn: 102-shot Fellowship fan trailer: shot-by-shot restyling
entries.titleZh: 《魔戒》同人预告：102 镜头逐镜风格转换
entries.summaryEn: Use the source edit as a pacing and continuity template: export frames for all 102 shots, restyle them in Sora, animate in Kling and Luma, then cut the regenerated shots back in sync. This is unofficial fan work, not a licensed trailer.
entries.summaryZh: 以原剪辑作为节奏模板：截取 102 个镜头，用 Sora 转绘，在 Kling 和 Luma 分别生成动作，最后对回原来的剪辑节奏。属于非官方同人实验。
entries.imageAltEn: Two synchronised film timelines with matching cuts
entries.imageAltZh: 上下两条剪辑时间线上一一对齐的切点

entries.titleEn: Princess Mononoke fan trailer: restoring composition shot by shot
entries.titleZh: 《幽灵公主》同人预告：逐镜重建构图和角色
entries.summaryEn: Historical case: use the original trailer as a shot map, generate character bases and visual descriptions, use controlled Midjourney character reference, animate selected frames in Kling, and rebuild the cut in Final Cut Pro. Original X post is reported withdrawn; use the creator’s Reddit copy to read it.
entries.summaryZh: 历史案例：用原预告作镜头图谱，先做角色基础素材，再用图像描述和可调人物参考重建构图，用 Kling 动画化，在 Final Cut Pro 对回原轨。X 原帖据报道撤下，以作者本人 Reddit 复贴作可读入口。

coverage.en: Includes all 19 publicly listed Beehiiv issues, 19 additional workflows from @PJaccetturo on X, and 16 original-thread links on existing entries. Only substantiated tutorials and production breakdowns are indexed. Some X posts may require sign-in; public creator sources and archives were used where needed. This is not a complete archive of the X account. No full posts or Skill files are mirrored.
coverage.zh: 保留 Beehiiv 公开归档的 19 篇文章；新增从 @PJaccetturo 的 X 找到的 19 篇不同实操教程或制作拆解，并给已有文章补了 16 个原帖入口。只收已核对的案例与工作流。部分 X 原帖在未登录时可能受限，故另以公开可读的作者内容或存档核验；并非 X 全账号的完整索引。不转载全文或镜像 Skill 文件。
